notes: Salesforce publishes no state, country or regional breakdown of employees, offices, investment or taxes for FY2026 (year ended Jan 31, 2026). The FY2026 10-K (Item 2) gives about 1.0 million sq ft of leased and owned property in the San Francisco Bay Area used for its executive and principal offices (plus about 2.2 million sq ft leased to others or available for lease), offices 'in various locations throughout the United States' and in Europe, North America, Asia, South America, Africa and Australia, and co-located data centers in the U.S., Europe and Asia, all without counts; it gives 83,334 employees in total with no geographic split. The FY26 Stakeholder Impact Report (checked Nov 24, 2026) has no geographic headcount either; its only location list is a water-risk map of priority sites, without values. The Hyderabad Centre of Excellence site is still cited from the FY25 Stakeholder Impact Report (still online), because the FY26 edition does not describe it. The IDC 'Salesforce Economy' white paper commissioned by Salesforce (Dec 2023) has no country table and only gives forecasts to 2028, so it was not used.
